body: The app makes accessing content so easy! I'm loving the daily deck to give you key ideas on your focus area, as well as the ability to easily set reminders of important messages you want for yourself. The only glitch I found was that anything I saved in my web library (including the workshop I was in middle of going through) did not transfer to my app library.

I've had the GI membership for almost a year and so far this app takes the membership to the next level. I originally thought I would cancel the membership after 3 months but my little ones keep changing so there is always more to come back for. I scheduled the app notification to come in at bedtime and it's reminder that goes off just when I need it. Thanks to the GI team for this app and if you're on the fence, never a better time then right now to join!

I know this app has a ton of good reviews, and everyone loves Dr. Becky. However, not even giving folks a chance to preview and test out a few small things in the app without payment feels so manipulative. It is incredibly expensive. Please make SOME small amounts of content available without having to pay so that parents can at least preview what they are paying for.
developer_reply: We hear you. We never want price to be prohibitive. Write us at support@goodinside.com and we can help!

body: I HIGHLY recommend this app. You can track input, output, accidents and it even provides graphs so that you can see the progress. The best part is that after logging a successful output into the toilet, there are 🎆 firework animation on your phone. My son liked this, and it encouraged him to go so that he could get the fireworks. There is also a paid version, but we didn't need that one.

This app started off AMAZING! Like I was recommending it to all of my friends. But after using it for a little while, all of a sudden the alarm feature on the timer isn't working right. It's not dependable to go off at the right time. Sometimes it requires me to click on the notification to go off. What I loved about the app was that the timer pretty much overruled all other apps like an alarm to remind me to remind toddler to go potty. So sad it stopped working. 😭

I loved it at first, which is why I paid for a month. After using it all day long for a few days in a row I noticed the timer is so glitchy. That's the main feature I rely on. It only goes off when it feels like it, I have to press the "dismiss" button multiple times for it to stop, sometimes the alarm continues unless I hard close the app, and it lags when I try to set a new timer. disappointing, I'll be looking for a new app
